name: gotho.blazorpdf
description: A simple PDF viewer component for use with Blazor

scripts.ts: npm run typecheck && npx esbuild Ts/PdfViewer.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=esnext --outfile=wwwroot/blazorpdf.min.js --sourcemap --keep-names
scripts.ts-min: npm run typecheck && npx esbuild Ts/PdfViewer.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=esnext --outfile=wwwroot/blazorpdf.min.js --minify --keep-names
